title: Employee Snapshot
supports: Snapshot is read-only. Search may open it when full profile access is absent; hover-card Snapshot is another entry. Fields follow access/directory policy; custom fields excluded in this release.

title: Multiple Review Cycles
supports: Cycles can target all employees or selected groups by department/division/title/status/location. Feedback is optional; assessments have cadence and custom questions. Current pixel layout not established.

title: Hire-date Review Cycles
supports: Setup supports calendar or hire-date-relative cycles, including new-hire milestones. Historical behavior source; current editor not visually validated.

title: Double-Blind Reviews
supports: Assessment Questions contains a double-blind setting. Default on means manager/employee answers remain mutually hidden until both are submitted. This is documented behavior, not a trial execution test.

title: Duplicate Review Cycles
supports: Duplicate preserves configuration/questions/ratings, creates a draft with Copy in its name and displays confirmation. Do not implement duplication as an active launch.

title: Performance Overview
supports: Public capabilities include self/manager/peer/skip-level reviews, goal tracking, 1:1s, segments, reminders and reports. Exact current editor layout is still unverified.

title: ATS and Offers
supports: Offer templates can vary by role/job type and populate candidate/role details; candidates can accept electronically. This does not establish the current template editor controls or signature persistence.

title: eNPS on Home
supports: Active surveys can be entered from Home on web/mobile. Vendor describes responses as anonymous; storage, identity unlinking and anonymity enforcement remain untested.

title: Mobile Satisfaction Survey
supports: Mobile help describes two questions: recommendation scale and score-dependent follow-up, followed by completion confirmation. Mobile description is not web-screen evidence.

title: Terms of Service
supports: Terms include restrictions on reverse engineering and using the service for competitive development. No further account capture was performed after this check; new gap resolution uses public documentation.
